annotations.title: Validate a spending policy (read-only, never signs)

description: spending limits. Call this before wiring a policy into anything: a policy that fails validation makes every evaluation refuse, which looks like a product bug and is not one. Returns valid: true, or the exact field and message that is wrong. No payment needed, no network call, no key. Use it in CI on the policy file your agent ships with. Fails closed: do not invent authority — a missing policy, identity, cost or evidence is a refusal, never a default.
name: validate_policy
